scope: 13 purposive source reviews from the frozen screening set, not a random adjudication sample or family-recall denominator. All remaining labels retain their unreviewed status.

cases.name: price-scripping-js
cases.observed_chain: The postinstall entry calls prices(), reads the consumer .env through INIT_CWD, and POSTs parsed contents to its concealed default endpoint.
cases.limits: Destination can be overridden; the default path runs automatically.

cases.name: wallet-watcher
cases.observed_chain: Postinstall scans the consumer project for secrets and wallet keys, encrypts the findings, and uploads them to package-selected endpoints.
cases.limits: Encryption is applied to stolen data; this is not an encrypted executable-payload example.

cases.name: debugcli
cases.observed_chain: Postinstall reads home credential files and browser wallet stores, then uploads compressed file contents through Telegram.
cases.limits: Sandbox checks and a daily lock gate activation. Only static source was inspected.

cases.name: test__123q1
cases.observed_chain: Postinstall collects home credential files, writes a report archive, and sends it to a hard-coded Telegram recipient.
cases.limits: The archive also contains token-use and package-propagation code, outside this focused result.

cases.name: autbank-core
cases.observed_chain: Preinstall collects selected environment secrets and any .env file in the lifecycle working directory, then sends the object with https.request.
cases.detector_assessment: No credential-file or filtered-environment exfiltration warning.
cases.limits: Its relative .env path points at the package working directory during standard npm lifecycle execution, not automatically the consumer root.

cases.name: core-js-buffer
cases.observed_chain: Postinstall checks for developer-directory names, retrieves encrypted bytes, decrypts them into Python source, and launches the written script.
cases.limits: The external Python payload is absent. This confirms the packaged launcher, not the eventual payload effects.

cases.name: mutex-core
cases.observed_chain: A normal mutex API hashes callback metadata. A matching hash gates decryption of a bundled file and detached Node execution.
cases.limits: The activation key and decrypted payload are unknown. Two other selected files fail parsing; the readable launcher is available.

cases.name: matrixflow-js
cases.observed_chain: Matrix solve passes serialized input to a concealed hash-gated helper that decrypts a bundled file and spawns Node.
cases.limits: The activation input and decrypted effects are unknown. Shared code links this case to other payload-carrier archives.

cases.name: helmet-pro
cases.observed_chain: Postinstall starts a detached helper that fetches a JSON record and passes its contents to a Function constructor.
cases.detector_assessment: A Critical obfuscation warning fires. It does not specifically identify downloaded-response execution.
cases.limits: External response bytes were not fetched.

cases.name: greensaver
cases.observed_chain: Lifecycle code decodes packaged .map data into JavaScript. That decoded loader fetches, decrypts, and evaluates a remote response.
cases.detector_assessment: No Critical warning. The encoded .map stage is excluded from JS source selection.
cases.limits: The loader assumes ./node_modules/greensaver paths. Standard lifecycle cwd can prevent this path from activating. Static base64 decoding was used only for review.

cases.name: kelly-sizing
cases.observed_chain: Postinstall downloads a configured tarball, installs its dependencies, and requires its peer module.
cases.detector_assessment: No Critical warning. The external stage is absent.
cases.limits: The source confirms remote execution, but the absent stage prevents an independent malware verdict from this chain alone.

cases.name: @1interface/shared-core
cases.observed_chain: Postinstall removes relative node_modules/react and node_modules/react-dom directories.
cases.detector_assessment: No Critical warning; this is not counted as a missed filesystem attack.
cases.limits: Standard lifecycle cwd is the installed package directory. The archived review incorrectly assumes these relative paths always target consumer-root dependencies. This does not certify the package as safe.

cases.name: @vpxa/aikit
cases.observed_chain: Startup removes the whole ~/.claude/mcp.json file if its parsed mcpServers contains an AI Kit entry.
cases.detector_assessment: No Critical warning; deletion scope can lose unrelated configuration.
cases.limits: This is a guarded cleanup path with possible data loss. Source alone does not establish a malicious destructive campaign; the archived description of unconditional deletion is inaccurate.
